what: Addendum to prediction_whole_corpus.json: BEIR HotpotQA, every passage encoded with the embedding NIM and searched exactly (cell H), and the 1b reranker on its results (cell H-R)
why: the two whole-corpus figures of this volume are Chinese and Japanese; this adds one English corpus of the same order of size, in its usual public packaging

encoding.started: as for the two MIRACL corpora: NIM_ENGINE_PRECISION=fp16, the model files of the image's own download mounted
encoding.program: encode_corpus_resumable.py --dataset beir-hotpotqa --piece 100000 --batch 64 --dim 2048 --stop-at <08:00 +0800 of the next morning>
encoding.passage_text: as the data-set reader gives it for BEIR (title, one space, text: retrieval_datasets.passage_text), input_type passage; queries input_type query; no prefix added by the client
encoding.night_only: the encoding runs in a night stretch and stops by itself at 08:00; if the corpus is not finished, a later night continues from the last checkpoint
encoding.checkpoints: results/hotpotqa_whole_corpus/full_corpus/beir-hotpotqa/checkpoints.jsonl (counts, seconds, SHA-256; no text); the vectors stay outside the repository
encoding.not_a_speed_figure: the seconds of a piece are recorded and are not a throughput figure

search.program: search_whole_corpus.py --dataset beir-hotpotqa --checkpoints ... --top 100 (cosine, exact, one piece in memory at a time)
search.metrics: nDCG@10 and Recall@100 on the test queries, by retrieval_metrics.py

controls.A_H (the search and the metric on this d: the same search restricted to a fixed subset of the corpus (every passage with a test judgement and the first 100,000 passages of the file) is computed twice: by search_whole_corpus.py with its restricted mode, and by a separate short program that loads the subset's vectors into one matrix and ranks with one matrix product. nDCG@10 and Recall@100 must agree to five decimals.
controls.C_H (ids and vectors belong together): after the encoding, 1,000 passages spread evenly over the file are encoded again in one new request stream and compared with the stored rows found by their ids: every cosine must be at least 0.999.
controls.already_shown_for_the_programs: the encoder against the first session's vectors (results/second_batch/full_corpus/program_check/), the search program on four reduced-corpus runs and on two restricted whole-corpus runs (cells A and C of the pre-registration)
controls.programs_of_the_two_controls: written after this freeze; their SHA-256 values are recorded in the results folder before their first use

cell_H.public_value: none for this model on this data set: the public MTEB results folder of the open weights (read 2026-10-03, MODEL_CARD_CLAIMS.json) holds no HotpotQA file, and the model card gives HotpotQA only inside a four-set average. The result is reported with the sentence 'no public value for this model'.

cell_H-R.what: as cell D: llama-nemotron-rerank-1b-v2 1.10.0 on the 100 results per query of cell H, one call per query; quality, then the duration of every call in two passes
cell_H-R.only_if: cell H is complete and both controls passed

expectations.encoding: between 400 and 1,000 passages per second (the passages are shorter than MIRACL's); the corpus is finished in one night stretch of about 10 hours or less
expectations.H: nDCG@10 between 0.66 and 0.82 and Recall@100 between 0.85 and 0.97 (a prior from figures published for other text-embedding models of this size, not looked up again for this file; there is no figure for this model)
expectations.H-R: nDCG@10 rises by 0.02 to 0.08; Recall@100 equal before and after
expectations.confidence: low for the quality range (no reference for this model), moderate for the rest

branches_decided_in_advance.a control fails: no figure of cell H is reported; the failure is the result
branches_decided_in_advance.the corpus is not finished at 08:00: the checkpoint file says where it stopped; nothing is searched until it is finished
branches_decided_in_advance.the result lies outside the expected ran: reported as measured, with the controls; no setting is changed to move it
